level_patch.story: Everything at once: a starved neighbourhood, a convoy nobody can fit, and one week to keep the whole table fed.

callout.title: The final week
callout.body: No new rules this city — just everything you already have, at the same time: the convoy that needs every bay, the quiet neighbourhood being starved, the short vehicles that could slip underneath. A black belt is one good week.

callout.title: Two modules, one mind
callout.body: Order decides who is next; the place card decides about the future — cones for the convoy, gaps rented to the short vehicles, the board watching every neighbourhood keep its share. This is the booth a real centre runs, written in twelve lines.

callout.title: You ran a whole centre
callout.body: Ordering, backfill, cones, fairness, the truck, the gate — you have placed every one of them by hand and automated every one of them behind your rules. The dojo's board is yours: nine cities, and the endless road if you want it forever.

callout.title: End of the week — and of the dojo
callout.body: Post your week on a card and watch someone else's campus argue with yours. The endless road never closes.
